taxonomy:
# Sign taxonomy

Label every physical traffic sign in each image. Use exactly these labels:

- `stop`: red octagon
- `yield`: inverted white triangle with a red rim
- `no-entry`: solid red disc with a white bar
- `speed-<n>`: white disc with a red rim showing the posted limit `<n>`
- `warning`: yellow diamond
- `school`: fluorescent yellow-green pentagon

Reflections on the road are not signs. A reflection is drawn with opacity below 0.5.
Faded but physical signs still count. The sun and the moon are not signs.

groups.title: Recurse into grouped signs
groups.lesson: Signs can sit inside <g transform=translate> groups; recurse and add the offset.

speed.title: Read speed-limit numerals
speed.lesson: A white disc with a red rim and a numeral is speed-<n>; a solid red disc is no-entry.

speed_bad.title: Every red-rimmed disc is a speed limit
speed_bad.lesson: Any red-rimmed disc is a speed limit; use speed-unknown when no numeral is visible.

warning.title: Rotated-square warning diamonds
warning.lesson: Warning diamonds may be drawn as yellow squares rotated 45 degrees.

warning_bad.title: Every yellow shape is a warning
warning_bad.lesson: Treat every yellow shape as a warning sign.

reflections.title: Skip road reflections
reflections.lesson: Shapes with opacity below 0.5 are reflections, not signs; skip them.

reflections_bad.title: Skip anything with an opacity attribute
reflections_bad.lesson: Ignore any element that sets an opacity attribute.

school.title: School-zone pentagons
school.lesson: A fluorescent yellow-green pentagon is a school sign; label it school.

school_bad.title: Every pentagon is a warning
school_bad.lesson: Treat any five-sided sign as a warning sign.

complete.title: Deliver only complete label files
complete.lesson: Deliver labels.json only after every image under images/ has an entry.

stages.notes: Read 42 warning(s) in the base rollouts. New edit: Recurse into grouped signs (new tool).
prompt_rules: Signs can sit inside <g transform=translate> groups; recurse and add the offset. (tool: scripts/recurse_offset.py)
stages.diff:
--- base/scripts/recurse_offset.py
+++ candidate/scripts/recurse_offset.py
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+"""Tool: Recurse into grouped signs.
+
+Signs can sit inside <g transform=translate> groups; recurse and add the offset.
+"""
+
+
+def install(hooks, api):
+    import re
+
+    ns = api["NS"]
+
+    def elements(root, dx=0.0, dy=0.0):
+        for el in root:
+            if el.tag == ns + "g":
+                m = re.search(r"translate\(([-\d.]+)[ ,]+([-\d.]+)\)", el.get("transform", ""))
+                ox, oy = (float(m.group(1)), float(m.group(2))) if m else (0.0, 0.0)
+                yield from elements(el, dx + ox, dy + oy)
+                continue
+            yield el, dx, dy
+
+    hooks["elements"] = elements
+
+
+def vision(spec):
+    pass

--- base/scripts/read_speed_limit.py
+++ candidate/scripts/read_speed_limit.py
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+"""Tool: Read speed-limit numerals.
+
+A white disc with a red rim and a numeral is speed-<n>; a solid red disc is no-entry.
+"""
+
+
+def install(hooks, api):
+    prev = hooks["circle"]
+
+    def circle(el, fill, stroke, digits, labels):
+        if stroke == api["RED"] and fill == api["WHITE"] and digits:
+            labels.append(f"speed-{digits[0]}")
+            return
+        prev(el, fill, stroke, digits, labels)
+
+    hooks["circle"] = circle
+
+
+def vision(spec):
+    spec["read_value"] = True
--- base/scripts/recurse_offset.py
+++ candidate/scripts/recurse_offset.py
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+"""Tool: Recurse into grouped signs.
+
+Signs can sit inside <g transform=translate> groups; recurse and add the offset.
+"""
+
+
+def install(hooks, api):
+    import re
+
+    ns = api["NS"]
+
+    def elements(root, dx=0.0, dy=0.0):
+        for el in root:
+            if el.tag == ns + "g":
+                m = re.search(r"translate\(([-\d.]+)[ ,]+([-\d.]+)\)", el.get("transform", ""))
+                ox, oy = (float(m.group(1)), float(m.group(2))) if m else (0.0, 0.0)
+                yield from elements(el, dx + ox, dy + oy)
+                continue
+            yield el, dx, dy
+
+    hooks["elements"] = elements
+
+
+def vision(spec):
+    pass
--- base/scripts/skip_reflection.py
+++ candidate/scripts/skip_reflection.py
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+"""Tool: Skip road reflections.
+
+Shapes with opacity below 0.5 are reflections, not signs; skip them.
+"""
+
+
+def install(hooks, api):
+    prev = hooks["skip"]
+
+    def skip(el, tag):
+        if float(el.get("opacity", 1)) < 0.5:
+            return True
+        return prev(el, tag)
+
+    hooks["skip"] = skip
+
+
+def vision(spec):
+    spec["rules"].append("A sign mirrored in a puddle or on wet road is a reflection, not a sign.")
+    spec["max_box_top"] = 0.7
--- base/scripts/warning_diamond.py
+++ candidate/scripts/warning_diamond.py
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+"""Tool: Rotated-square warning diamonds.
+
+Warning diamonds may be drawn as yellow squares rotated 45 degrees.
+"""
+
+
+def install(hooks, api):
+    prev = hooks["rect"]
+
+    def rect(el, fill, labels):
+        if fill == api["YELLOW"] and "rotate(45" in el.get("transform", ""):
+            labels.append("warning")
+            return
+        prev(el, fill, labels)
+
+    hooks["rect"] = rect
+
+
+def vision(spec):
+    spec["classes"]["warning"] += ", including a yellow square turned 45 degrees"

+"""Tool: Recurse into grouped signs.
+
+Signs can sit inside <g transform=translate> groups; recurse and add the offset.
+"""
+
+
+def install(hooks, api):
+    import re
+
+    ns = api["NS"]
+
+    def elements(root, dx=0.0, dy=0.0):
+        for el in root:
+            if el.tag == ns + "g":
+                m = re.search(r"translate\(([-\d.]+)[ ,]+([-\d.]+)\)", el.get("transform", ""))
+                ox, oy = (float(m.group(1)), float(m.group(2))) if m else (0.0, 0.0)
+                yield from elements(el, dx + ox, dy + oy)
+                continue
+            yield el, dx, dy
+
+    hooks["elements"] = elements
+
+
+def vision(spec):
+    pass

--- base/scripts/read_speed_limit.py
+++ candidate/scripts/read_speed_limit.py
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+"""Tool: Read speed-limit numerals.
+
+A white disc with a red rim and a numeral is speed-<n>; a solid red disc is no-entry.
+"""
+
+
+def install(hooks, api):
+    prev = hooks["circle"]
+
+    def circle(el, fill, stroke, digits, labels):
+        if stroke == api["RED"] and fill == api["WHITE"] and digits:
+            labels.append(f"speed-{digits[0]}")
+            return
+        prev(el, fill, stroke, digits, labels)
+
+    hooks["circle"] = circle
+
+
+def vision(spec):
+    spec["read_value"] = True
--- base/scripts/recurse_offset.py
+++ candidate/scripts/recurse_offset.py
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+"""Tool: Recurse into grouped signs.
+
+Signs can sit inside <g transform=translate> groups; recurse and add the offset.
+"""
+
+
+def install(hooks, api):
+    import re
+
+    ns = api["NS"]
+
+    def elements(root, dx=0.0, dy=0.0):
+        for el in root:
+            if el.tag == ns + "g":
+                m = re.search(r"translate\(([-\d.]+)[ ,]+([-\d.]+)\)", el.get("transform", ""))
+                ox, oy = (float(m.group(1)), float(m.group(2))) if m else (0.0, 0.0)
+                yield from elements(el, dx + ox, dy + oy)
+                continue
+            yield el, dx, dy
+
+    hooks["elements"] = elements
+
+
+def vision(spec):
+    pass
--- base/scripts/skip_reflection.py
+++ candidate/scripts/skip_reflection.py
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+"""Tool: Skip road reflections.
+
+Shapes with opacity below 0.5 are reflections, not signs; skip them.
+"""
+
+
+def install(hooks, api):
+    prev = hooks["skip"]
+
+    def skip(el, tag):
+        if float(el.get("opacity", 1)) < 0.5:
+            return True
+        return prev(el, tag)
+
+    hooks["skip"] = skip
+
+
+def vision(spec):
+    spec["rules"].append("A sign mirrored in a puddle or on wet road is a reflection, not a sign.")
+    spec["max_box_top"] = 0.7
--- base/scripts/warning_diamond.py
+++ candidate/scripts/warning_diamond.py
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+"""Tool: Rotated-square warning diamonds.
+
+Warning diamonds may be drawn as yellow squares rotated 45 degrees.
+"""
+
+
+def install(hooks, api):
+    prev = hooks["rect"]
+
+    def rect(el, fill, labels):
+        if fill == api["YELLOW"] and "rotate(45" in el.get("transform", ""):
+            labels.append("warning")
+            return
+        prev(el, fill, labels)
+
+    hooks["rect"] = rect
+
+
+def vision(spec):
+    spec["classes"]["warning"] += ", including a yellow square turned 45 degrees"

+"""Tool: Recurse into grouped signs.
